methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The energy consumption data of the ceramics sanitary production would be applied by multiple linear regression to analyze factors, which affect the energy consumption of these industries.

paper_type.evidence_quote: aims to evaluate the energy utilization index of ceramic sanitary industries in Thailand from 2014 to 2015

stage1.notes: level_3b=false: sector is sanitary ceramics (non-metallic ceramic industry); ceramics is NOT on the closed continuous-process Level-3B list (glass is; ceramics is a distinct, excluded sector). paper_type borderline: sector-level benchmark pooling 4 of 10 factories into one regression baseline (single applied case) vs multi-case (4 factories).

country_region.evidence_quote: ceramic sanitary industries in Thailand from 2014 to 2015

sector_of_activity.evidence_quote: energy conservation opportunities at a sanitary ceramics sector

type_of_organisation.evidence_quote: The largest energy consumption was during the firing process in the kiln.

regulatory_driver.evidence_quote: the Ministerial Regulation issued under the Energy Conservation Promotion Act (ECP Act)

evidence_quote: Multiple linear regression attempts to model the relationship between two or more explanatory variables and a response variable by fitting a linear equation to observed data.
